items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: George Williams is a drummer. That's one of the drummers in that band.

ctx.x: How do you say it? Delvar. Delvar. Delvar. Delvar. And you don't know this trombone then I guess? Yeah, that's George of Jamont. Oh yes. That's a French one too.
Harold Dejan doesn't remember. Yeah George of Jamont.
